nonClaims: D10 does not validate perspective projection, subpixel resampling or deformation motion.
D10 excludes transparency, multi-owner pixels, volumetrics, hair, depth of field and motion blur.
D10 validates Object Index only for opaque single-owner pixels and does not validate Cryptomatte.
D10 does not run the D9.1 accumulator on real rendered beauty pixels and does not claim temporal image quality.
D10 does not claim cross-engine, cross-version, cross-operating-system or cross-GPU equivalence.
D10 does not claim cinematic quality or human preference.
